blocks.text: וְעֵינַי תְּלוּיוֹת. רְאוֹת כְּנוּס גָּלֻיּוֹת. בְּקוֹל גֹּדֶל שׁוֹפָר: רְבִיעִית חַיּוֹת. לִיקוֹד לִהְיוֹת. רֶשֶׁף שַׁלְהֲבִיוֹת. בְּקוֹל לַהַב שׁוֹפָר: שֵׁנָה תְּעוֹרֵר. לְשַׁלֵּם גְּמוּל לְצוֹרֵר. שְׁאוֹנוֹ תְפוֹרֵר. בְּקוֹל גְּבוּרוֹת שׁוֹפָר: שׁוֹשָׁן תַּדְרֵר. גְּאֻלָּה תְבָרֵר. שׁוֹכְנִים תְּזוֹרֵר. בְּקוֹל הַעֲרַת שׁוֹפָר: תְּיַשֵּׁר מֵחֶרְמוֹן. לְרוֹעַ אַדְמוֹן. תַּשְׁלֵג בְּצַלְמוֹן. בְּקוֹל הֲמוֹן שׁוֹפָר: תִּצְעַד כְּבִישִׁימוֹן. בְּמַתַּן אָמוֹן. תַּשְׁמִיעַ בְּאַרְמוֹן. קוֹל קוֹרֵא כַּשּׁוֹפָר:

blocks.text: The fourth of the wild beasts (that Daniel saw) will fall into the fire, among the sparking flames at the fiery sound of the Shofar. Thou wilt stir up sleep to pay retribution to the oppressor, and shatter his multitudes with the mighty sound of the Shofar. Thou wilt free the Rose (Israel) and let redemption dawn, revive those who slumber with the rousing sound of the Shofar. Thou wilt march from Hermon to destroy Admon, bring cooling to Tsalmon with the massive sound of the Shofar. Thou wilt step in our midst as once in the wilderness when Thou didst give us the Torah and once again wilt Thou allow to be heard in the Sanctuary a voice that sounds like that of the Shofar.

As it is written in Thy Torah: ‘And it happened on the third day during the morning that there was thunder and lightning and a heavy cloud lay over the mountain and there was a very powerful sound of the Shofar and all the people in the camp were afraid’. And it was said: ‘And the sound of the Shofar grew very powerful, Moses was speaking and God was answering him aloud’. And it was said: ‘And all the people were seeing the thunder and the lightning and the sound of the Shofar and the mountain in smoke, the people saw and trembled and stood at a distance’. blocks.text: There will be stirring from the grave, a shout from the rock when the dry bones from the dust give voice. Witness the banner on the mountains and the sound of the Shofar on earth when there is heard the exultation of those long silent of voice.
As it is written through Thy prophet: ‘All inhabitants of the world and dwellers on earth, when the banner is raised on the mountains shall you see and when the Shofar is blown shall you hear’.

No longer shall the heart mocked by error refuse to incline, no longer shall the ear be deaf and not hear the voice. Restore to me as of old the law of my inheritance, as when Thou didst shatter me with lightning and the voice.
